info.title: SKU.io — Find a Product
info.description: Look up a product in the SKU.io catalog by SKU, barcode, or a free-text search over name and SKU. Use this whenever you need to resolve a product reference to its SKU.io product record and id — for example before adding it to a sales order, checking stock, or reporting on it.

get.summary: Fuzzy search products by name or SKU fragment.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Text to match against product name and SKU. The parameter is named `q` — `query` and `search` are NOT read by the API and are silently ignored. Because `q` is optional, sending the wrong name returns an unfiltered page of the most recent active products with a 200, which reads like a successful search. Minimum 2 characters. Omit only when you deliberately want that recent-products default.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum rows to return, 1-50 (default 10). This endpoint is NOT a paginator — there is no `page` / `per_page` and no pagination envelope. Raise `limit` instead of paging.
